import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Fill NaN values in 'Sleep Disorder' with 'None' for clarity in visualization
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None', inplace=True)
# Split 'Blood Pressure' into 'Systolic' and 'Diastolic' columns for numerical analysis
df[['Systolic_BP', 'Diastolic_BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# --- Visualization ---
# Set the overall theme and style for the plot
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure with a 2x2 grid of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Analysis of Sleep Health by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=20, weight='bold')

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs. Stress Level
sns.violinplot(
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Disorder',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    palette='viridis',
    inner='quartile'
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Disorder', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=10)

# Plot 2: Quality of Sleep vs. Physical Activity
sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    data=df,
    x='Physical Activity Level',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Stress Level',
    sizes=(30, 200),
    palette='magma',
    alpha=0.7
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sleep Quality vs. Physical Activity', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (minutes/day)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Sleep Disorder & Stress')

# Plot 3: Blood Pressure by BMI Category and Gender
sns.stripplot(
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    data=df,
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Systolic_BP',
    hue='Gender',
    palette='coolwarm',
    dodge=True,
    alpha=0.8,
    jitter=0.2
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Systolic Blood Pressure by BMI Category', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Systolic Blood Pressure (mmHg)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].axhline(120, color='grey', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
axes[1, 0].text(3.5, 121, 'Normal Threshold', color='grey', va='bottom', ha='right')


# Plot 4: Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features
# Select only numerical columns for correlation
numerical_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['float64', 'int64']).columns.tolist()
# Remove identifier and the newly created BP columns for a cleaner heatmap
cols_to_exclude = ['Person ID', 'Systolic_BP', 'Diastolic_BP']
heatmap_cols = [col for col in numerical_cols if col not in cols_to_exclude]

corr = df[heatmap_cols].corr()
mask = [[False, True, True, True, True, True],
        [False, False, True, True, True, True],
        [False, False, False, True, True, True],
        [False, False, False, False, True, True],
        [False, False, False, False, False, True],
        [False, False, False, False, False, False]]


sns.heatmap(
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    data=corr,
    annot=True,
    cmap='cividis',
    fmt=".2f",
    linewidths=.5,
    mask=mask # Show only the lower triangle
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Correlation Matrix of Key Metrics', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='y', rotation=0)


# Adjust layout to prevent titles from overlapping
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
